<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#c5a06b">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Dicelma & Núrio">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="format-detection" content="telephone=no"
html {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100%;
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
}

body {
    margin: 0;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100%;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}>

<title>Dicelma & Núrio — Convite de Casamento</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;500;600&family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600&family=Parisienne&display=swap');

:root {
  --gold:#b9965a; --gold2:#d7bd8b; --cream:#fbf8f2; --ink:#5e513f;
}
* { box-sizing:border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior:smooth; }
body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100%;
    overflow-x: hidden;

    background: #fbf8f1;
    color: #302c27;

    font-family: Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif;

    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;

    text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}
body::before {
    content: "";
    position: fixed;
    inset: -50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle, rgba(184,155,98,.12) 0 2px, transparent 3px);
    background-size: 70px 70px;
    animation: moveParticles 25s linear infinite;
    opacity: .35;
    z-index: -1;
}

@keyframes moveParticles {
    from {
        transform: translate(0,0);
    }
    to {
        transform: translate(70px,70px);
    }
}
.cover {
  width:min(470px,100%); min-height:760px; border-radius:22px;
  overflow:hidden; position:relative; box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(80,60,30,.18);
  background:#fff; border:1px solid rgba(185,150,90,.35);
}
.cover img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block; }
.cover-overlay {
  position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-end;
  align-items:center; padding:34px 24px;
  background:linear-gradient(transparent 55%, rgba(35,25,15,.52));
}
.open-btn {
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85); background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);
  color:var(--gold); padding:15px 28px; border-radius:40px; font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:2px; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.16);
}
#invite { display:none; }
.container { width:min(900px,100%); margin:auto; }
.hero {
  min-height:100dvh; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; text-align:center;
  padding:50px 20px;
}
.card {
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.86); backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  border:1px solid rgba(185,150,90,.28); border-radius:26px; padding:42px 25px;
  box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(80,60,30,.10);
}
.kicker { letter-spacing:5px; font-size:11px; color:var(--gold); text-transform:uppercase; }
.names {
  font-family:Parisienne,cursive; font-size:clamp(58px,14vw,100px);
  font-weight:400; line-height:.95; color:var(--gold); margin:18px 0;
}
.and { font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif; font-size:34px; color:#806d51; }
.subtitle { font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif; font-size:23px; line-height:1.35; }
.date { margin:28px 0; font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif; }
.date .day { font-size:86px; line-height:.8; color:var(--gold); }
.date strong { display:block; letter-spacing:6px; font-size:13px; margin:12px 0; }
.date small { letter-spacing:5px; font-size:12px; }
.countdown { display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:10px; margin:25px 0 5px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.timebox { min-width:70px; padding:12px 8px; border:1px solid rgba(185,150,90,.35); border-radius:14px; }
.timebox b { display:block; font-size:25px; color:var(--gold); }
.timebox span { font-size:9px; letter-spacing:1.5px; }
.section { padding:55px 20px; }
.section h2 { font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif; font-size:38px; text-align:center; font-weight:500; margin:0 0 12px; color:#7d694c; }
.section .lead { text-align:center; font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif; font-size:20px; }
.details { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr)); gap:15px; margin-top:25px; }
.detail {
  padding:25px; text-align:center; background:white; border-radius:18px;
  border:1px solid rgba(185,150,90,.22);
}
.icon { font-size:27px; }
.detail h3 { margin:10px 0 7px; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:2px; text-transform:uppercase; }
.detail p { margin:0; line-height:1.6; font-size:14px; }
.actions { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; justify-content:center; margin-top:25px; }
.btn {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; text-decoration:none;
  padding:14px 20px; border-radius:30px; border:1px solid var(--gold);
  color:white; background:var(--gold); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:1px;
}
.btn.alt { color:var(--gold); background:white; }
.note {
  text-align:center; font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif; font-size:25px; line-height:1.35;
  padding:35px 20px;
}
.footer { text-align:center; padding:40px 20px 70px; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:2px; color:#8c7a60; }
.reveal { opacity:0; transform:translateY(22px); transition:.8s ease; }
.reveal.show { opacity:1; transform:none; }
.fade-in { animation:fade .9s ease both; }
@keyframes fade { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)} to{opacity:1;transform:none} }
@media(max-width:500px) {
 .cover { min-height:700px; }
 .card { padding:35px 18px; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="cover" class="screen">
  <div class="cover">
    <img src=data:image/png;base64, alt="Convite de casamento de Dicelma e Núrio">

    <div class="cover-overlay">
      <button class="open-btn" onclick="openInvite()">✦ ABRIR CONVITE ✦</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<main id="invite">
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="card fade-in">
        <div class="kicker">Nosso casamento</div>
        <div class="names">Dicelma<br><span class="and">&amp;</span><br>Núrio</div>
        <div class="subtitle">Com o coração transbordando de alegria,<br>convidamos você para celebrar connosco.</div>
        <div class="date">
          <strong>OUTUBRO</strong>
          <div class="day">30</div>
          <small>SEXTA-FEIRA · 15:30 · 2026</small>
        </div>
        <div id="countdown" class="countdown"></div>
        <div class="actions">
          <a class="btn" href="#detalhes">VER DETALHES</a>
          <a class="btn alt" href="#rsvp">CONFIRMAR PRESENÇA</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="detalhes" class="section">
    <div class="container">
      <h2>Um dia para celebrar o amor</h2>
      <p class="lead">Esperamos você para tornar este momento ainda mais especial.</p>
      <div class="details">
        <div class="detail reveal">
          <div class="icon">📅</div>
          <h3>Data</h3>
          <p>30 de Outubro de 2026<br>Sexta-feira</p>
        </div>
        <div class="detail reveal">
          <div class="icon">🕜</div>
          <h3>Horário</h3>
          <p>15h30</p>
        </div>
        <div class="detail reveal">
          <div class="icon">📍</div>
          <h3>Local</h3>
          <p>Talatona, Condomínio Palanca Negra<br>Casa Nº 38</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="actions reveal">
        <a class="btn"
   href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/Lx1n8uj3P4uwPrBt6?g_st=ac"
   target="_blank"
   rel="noopener">ABRIR NO GOOGLE MAPS</a>
        <a class="btn alt" href="data:text/calendar;charset=utf-8,BEGIN:VCALENDAR%0AVERSION:2.0%0ABEGIN:VEVENT%0ADTSTART:20261030T133000%0ADTEND:20261030T170000%0ASUMMARY:Casamento%20Diclema%20%26%20N%C3%BArio%0ALOCATION:Condom%C3%ADnio%20Palanca%20Negra%2C%20Casa%2038%2C%20Talatona%2C%20Luanda%0AEND:VEVENT%0AEND:VCALENDAR" download="casamento-diclema-nurio.ics">ADICIONAR À AGENDA</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="section">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="card reveal">
        <div class="note">“Deus uniu nossos caminhos e nós,sob sua bênção, uniremos nossas vidas para sempre.”</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="rsvp" class="section">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="card reveal" style="text-align:center">
        <h2>Confirme a sua presença</h2>
        <p class="lead">Será uma alegria ter você connosco neste dia tão especial.</p>
        <div class="actions">
          <!-- Substitua 244935535154 pelo número de WhatsApp do casal, com indicativo 244 -->
          <a class="btn" 
   href="https://wa.me/244935535154"
   target="_blank"
   rel="noopener">CONFIRMAR PELO WHATSAPP</a>
        </div>
        <p style="font-size:11px;opacity:.65;margin-top:16px"></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer class="footer">DICELMA &amp; NÚRIO · 30.10.2026 ·</footer>
</main>

<script>
function openInvite(){
  document.getElementById('cover').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('invite').style.display='block';
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach((el,i)=>setTimeout(()=>el.classList.add('show'),150+i*100));
}
const target = new Date('2026-10-30T13:30:00+01:00').getTime();
function tick(){
  const now=Date.now(), d=Math.max(0,target-now);
  const days=Math.floor(d/86400000);
  const hrs=Math.floor(d/3600000)%24;
  const min=Math.floor(d/60000)%60;
  const sec=Math.floor(d/1000)%60;
  const box=document.getElementById('countdown');
  box.innerHTML=`<div class="timebox"><b>${days}</b><span>DIAS</span></div>
  <div class="timebox"><b>${String(hrs).padStart(2,'0')}</b><span>HORAS</span></div>
  <div class="timebox"><b>${String(min).padStart(2,'0')}</b><span>MIN</span></div>
  <div class="timebox"><b>${String(sec).padStart(2,'0')}</b><span>SEG</span></div>`;
}
tick(); setInterval(tick,1000);
</script>
</body>
</html>
